tools.name: check_window_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user has a 17-character VIN and wants to know what the vehicle is (year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, body, assembly plant), whether the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) is on file for that VIN, how many recalls were issued for the model, and where to find

tools.name: get_original_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the contents of the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) for a 17-character VIN: total MSRP, base price, destination charge, every factory option and package with its price, exterior and interior colour, engine, transmission, fuel economy, standard equipment,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_original_sticker" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
